DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入力する金額の確認をご希望ですね。お持ちの書類は、今回の請求書でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the amount to enter, correct? Is the document you have the invoice for this payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書と前の見積書を持っています。見積書の合計を入れようとしましたが、請求書には支払済みの欄があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見積合計を使いかけたが請求書に支払済み欄があると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the invoice and the earlier estimate. I was about to enter the estimate's total, but the invoice has a field for an amount already paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you almost used the estimate's total but the invoice has an already-paid field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払済みの欄があるのですね。ここで今回の正しい振込額を計算して決めることはできません。請求元の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is an already-paid field, then. We cannot calculate and decide the correct transfer amount here. Has the issuer specified it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今回請求額という欄はあります。ただ、その金額に送料が含まれるか、別の注意書きと合わせて読むとわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回額の欄はあるが送料の注意書きとの関係が不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a field called “Amount billed this time.” But reading it together with another note, I cannot tell whether shipping is included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is a current-amount field but its relationship to the shipping note is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点は請求元に確認しましょう。相手が指定した額と、手続きにかかる費用の確認も分けておきたいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check that with the invoice issuer. We should also distinguish the amount they specify from the fees for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求元には送料と支払済み分を聞きます。銀行での費用を、請求額から勝手に引いてよいとも考えない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送料と既払分を請求元へ聞き銀行費用を勝手に差し引かないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask the issuer about shipping and the amount already paid. I should not assume I can deduct the bank's fees from the billed amount on my own, either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the issuer about shipping and prior payment, and confirm you will not deduct bank fees on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引くかどうかを自己判断せず、支払う条件を請求元へ確認してください。銀行の費用は手続きの案内で別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not decide yourself whether to deduct them; check the payment terms with the issuer. We will check bank fees separately in the procedure information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手への支払条件と銀行の費用を分けて聞きます。今日は金額を入力せず、請求書の欄に質問の印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支払条件と銀行費用を別々に聞き今日は金額を入れず欄に印を付けると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask separately about payment terms and bank fees. I will not enter an amount today; I will mark the invoice field with a question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about terms and bank fees separately, not enter an amount today, and mark the field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した回答も請求書と一緒に残すと、次の相談で違いを説明できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you keep their answer with the invoice, you can explain the difference at the next consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 回答を残し、今回振り込む額が確認できてから入力を相談します。見積書の合計をそのまま使わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答を残して今回額を確かめ見積合計をそのまま使わず再相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the answer and ask about entering the amount once the amount to transfer this time is confirmed. I will avoid using the estimate's total as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the answer, confirm the current amount, and say you will consult again without directly using the estimate's total. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、請求元の返事を受けてからまたご相談ください。その際に今回の支払いと費用を順に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please come back after receiving the issuer's reply. We will check this payment and the fees in order then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に伺います。商品は全部まとめてよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we check out, may I ask whether all the items should be put through together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の分と母に頼まれた分が混ざっています。母の分はレシートを別にしたいので、今分けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と母の買物が混ざり母用レシートを別にするため今分けたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shopping is mixed with items my mother asked for. I would like a separate receipt for hers; may I separate them now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your and your mother's shopping is mixed, and ask to separate it now for a separate receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読み取る前に分けましょう。どの商品がお母様の分か、こちら側へまとめていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us separate them before scanning. Could you put your mother's items together on this side?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンと牛乳が母の分です。自分の野菜は反対側へ置きますが、牛乳は先に袋へ入れないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パンと牛乳が母で野菜が自分と伝え会計前に袋へ入れないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bread and milk are my mother's. I will put my vegetables on the other side, but leave the milk out of the bag for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the bread and milk are your mother's and the vegetables yours; do not bag them before checkout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会計後に袋へ分けて入れましょう。お母様の分とご自身の分は、同じ方法で支払いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us bag them separately after payment. Will you pay the same way for your mother's items and yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母の分は預かった現金で、自分の分はこの練習用カードで払いたいです。現金の方を先にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母は預かり現金で自分は練習用カードと示し現金を先に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to pay for hers with the cash she gave me, and mine with this practice card. Please do the cash payment first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the mother's cash and your practice card, and ask to pay cash first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの会計として伺います。カードについては表示を確認してから進めます。袋も二つお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will handle them as separate transactions. We will check the display before proceeding with the card. Have you brought two bags as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つ持っています。赤い袋が母の分で、黒い袋が自分の分です。レシートも別々の袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤が母で黒が自分の袋と説明し各レシートも分けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The red bag is for my mother's items and the black one for mine. I will put each receipt in its own bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that red is your mother's and black yours, and that you will separate the receipts too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の色で区別するのですね。現金のお釣りをカードの会計と混ぜないよう、先にしまっていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you distinguish them by bag color. Could you put the cash change away first so it does not get mixed up with the card transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母のレシートとお釣りを先に赤い袋へしまってから、自分のカード払いを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 母の釣銭とレシートを赤袋にしまってから自分のカード会計へ進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put my mother's receipt and change in the red bag first, then proceed with my own card payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put your mother's change and receipt in the red bag before your card transaction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お母様の分から金額を確認します。それでは、二つの袋とレシートをご確認のうえ、お持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the amount for your mother's items first. Please check both bags and receipts before taking them home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広場から練習の音が聞こえていますね。そちらの催しをご覧になるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We can hear practice sounds from the plaza. Are you planning to watch the event there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 催しではなく、静かな所で本を読んでから歩きたいです。広場を通らない道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 催しでなく読書と散歩のため広場を通らない道を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am not going to the event; I would like to read somewhere quiet and then walk. Is there a route that avoids the plaza?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a route avoiding the plaza for reading and walking rather than the event. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用園内図では、木立の外側を回る道が広場から離れています。まず休む場所から決めましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice park map, the path around the outside of the grove is away from the plaza. Shall we choose a resting place first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木立の入口にある休憩所で読みたいです。そこから歩いて、また同じ所に戻れる経路を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木立入口の休憩所で読み散歩後に同じ所へ戻りたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to read at the rest area by the grove entrance. I would like a walking route that brings me back there afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to read at the rest area by the grove entrance and return there after walking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の細い道は行き止まりで、太い線の道は休憩所へ戻る形です。線の違いを見てお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The thin path on the map is a dead end; the thick-lined path loops back to the rest area. Choose by checking the difference between the lines.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 太い線の道を選びます。歩いている間に練習の人が道へ出てきたら、その間を抜けずに待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 太線の道を選び練習者が出たら間を抜けず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will choose the thick-lined path. If people practicing come onto it while I walk, I would like to wait rather than pass between them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the thick-lined path and say you will wait rather than pass between people practicing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場の案内に従ってください。待つときは通路の真ん中を避け、係がいる場所で状況を尋ねられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow the instructions on site. When waiting, avoid the middle of the walkway; you can ask about the situation where a staff member is stationed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 係がいる所で尋ねます。本を読みながら歩くと道を見落としそうなので、歩く間はかばんへしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 係へ尋ねると答え道を見落とさないよう本をかばんにしまうと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask where there is a staff member. I might miss the path if I read while walking, so I will put the book in my bag while moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask staff and put the book away to avoid overlooking the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元と表示を確認しやすくなりますね。休憩所へ戻る方向が不明なら、図と現在地を照らしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will make it easier to check your footing and signs. If you are unsure which way returns to the rest area, compare the map with your location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本をしまって表示を見ながら歩きます。音が気になれば広場へ近づかず、図で休憩所へ戻る方向を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本をしまい表示を見て音が気になれば広場を避け図で休憩所への向きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the book away and walk while checking signs. If the sound bothers me, I will avoid approaching the plaza and use the map to check the direction back to the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put the book away, check signs, and if the noise bothers you avoid the plaza and check the map for the rest area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、図をお持ちになって休憩所へどうぞ。それでは、読書と散歩の時間をゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the map and go to the rest area. Enjoy a relaxing time reading and walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の混雑についての掲示をご覧ですね。ご予約の便について確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the road-congestion notice. Would you like to check your booked service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。道路が混んでいると書いてあるので、予約したバスを別の便に変えなければならないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 道路混雑の表示を予約便の変更が必要という意味に取ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says the road is congested, so I thought I had to change my reserved bus to another service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you interpreted the congestion notice as meaning a change to your booking was necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 混雑の掲示だけで予約変更が必要とは判断できません。予約の案内をお見せいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The congestion notice alone does not tell us you need to change the booking. May I see your booking information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面です。出発する場所と便の番号があります。変更の操作をする前に、この便の状況を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約画面の出発場所と便番号を示し操作前に状況を聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is on this screen. It shows the departure location and service number. Before making a change, I would like to ask about this service's status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the departure location and service number on the booking screen, and ask about status before making changes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 便の番号で担当へ確認します。到着後に時刻が決まったご予定がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with the responsible staff using the service number. Do you have plans at a fixed time after arriving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知人と昼食の約束がありますが、席は予約していません。到着が分かるまで食事の時刻を決め直すのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昼食の席は未予約で到着が分かるまで食事時刻を変えるのを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have plans to have lunch with an acquaintance, but we have not booked seats. I will wait to change the meal time until I know when I will arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say lunch seats are not booked and you will wait to change the meal time until arrival is known. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 到着の見込みもまだ確認中とお伝えください。出発の案内を待つ場所は決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them the estimated arrival is still being checked too. Have you decided where to wait for departure information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 売店で待とうと思っていました。案内を見られる待合の場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売店で待つつもりだったが出発案内の分かる待合を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was thinking of waiting at the shop. Please tell me a waiting area where I can see the information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you had planned to wait at the shop and ask for a waiting area with departure information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 待合の表示を一緒に確認しましょう。席を離れるときも、ご自身の便の案内を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the waiting-area signs together. Even when leaving your seat, check the information for your own service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 便の番号を控えて待合で待ちます。知人には確認中と知らせ、出発が分かったらまた連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 便番号を控え待合で待ち知人には確認中と出発確認後の再連絡を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the service number and wait in the waiting area. I will tell my acquaintance I am still checking, and contact them again once departure is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the service number, wait in the waiting area, and tell your acquaintance you are checking and will contact them after departure is confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当の案内をお待ちください。ご予約の便を確かめてから、気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait for the responsible staff's information. Check your booked service before setting off, and travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談のお申込みですね。これまでに電話や窓口で連絡されたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to apply for a consultation. Have you contacted us by phone or at a counter before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母が私の相談について電話したと言っています。私は画面から申し込もうとしていて、同じ予約が二つになるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母の電話と自分の画面申込みが同じ予約になるか心配と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother says she phoned about my consultation. I am about to apply on screen, and I am worried it might make two bookings for the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain concern that your mother's call and your screen application could duplicate the booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、お母さまが何を申し込んだのか確認しましょう。日時のメモを受け取っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first check what your mother applied for. Have you received a note of the date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相談の説明を聞いたとだけ言われ、日時は分かりません。予約が済んだとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 母から説明を聞いたとだけ聞き日時不明で予約済みとは限らないと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: She only told me she heard an explanation of the consultation; I do not know the date or time. So that does not necessarily mean the booking is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you only heard that your mother received an explanation, do not know the date or time, and confirm it may not be booked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その点を確認してから進めるとよいですね。お母さまへ今連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be best to check that first. Can you contact your mother now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方なら話せます。担当の名前、予約した日時、受付の返答があるかを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕方に担当名と予約日時と受付返答を母に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can speak to her in the evening. I will ask the staff member's name, booked date and time, and whether there was a response from reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask your mother that evening about the staff name, booked date and time, and reception's response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人が相談することも伝えましょう。相談の内容は短く説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Also explain that you yourself will be having the consultation. Can you briefly explain the topic?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事と家庭の予定が重なり、利用できる相談先を探しています。母の相談とは分けて、自分の用件として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事家庭の予定に関する相談先を求め母の相談と区別すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Work and family schedules overlap, and I am looking for somewhere I can get advice. I will present it as my own request, separately from my mother's consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you seek advice about work and family schedules and distinguish it from your mother's consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かった情報をもとに担当へ確認できます。画面の申込みは今進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check with the responsible staff using what you find out. Will you proceed with the on-screen application now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 重複しないよう今日は送信せず、母への確認後に受付へ連絡します。途中で入力した内容は控えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面を送信せず入力内容を控え母に確認してから受付へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: To avoid duplication, I will not submit it today; I will contact reception after checking with my mother. I will keep a note of what I have entered so far.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not submit the screen; keep the entered content and contact reception after checking with your mother. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認した日時とご自身の用件をそろえてまたご相談ください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come back with the confirmed date and time and your own request ready. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計後の書類についてですね。何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about documents after payment. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に受診の書類を出します。領収書の原本を渡すと手元になくなるので、写しでよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社提出で領収書を失わないため写しでよいか迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will submit proof of my medical visit to my company. If I give them the original receipt, I will no longer have it, so I am unsure whether a copy is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you are unsure about using a copy so you do not lose the receipt when submitting to the company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社がどちらを求めるかは、提出先に確かめてください。依頼文には原本と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check with the recipient which your company requires. Does the request say “original”?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 依頼文には受診した日の分としかありません。原本か写しか、会社に聞いてから扱いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受診日の指定だけなので原本か写しかを会社へ聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It only says the document for the day I saw the doctor. I want to ask the company whether they need the original or a copy before handling it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say only the visit date is specified, so you will ask the company whether original or copy is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの書類は、その間なくさないよう保管してください。別の書類も一緒に渡されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep these documents safe in the meantime. Were you given another document too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明細書もあります。二枚を別々に撮って名前を付け、どちらのことか会社へ質問できるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 領収書と明細書を別々に記録して名前を付け会社に質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an itemized statement too. I will photograph the two separately and label them so I can ask the company which one they mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record and label the receipt and itemized statement separately to ask the company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類名を区別すると伝えやすいですね。再び発行してもらえるかも気になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Distinguishing document names will make it easier to explain. Are you also wondering whether they can be reissued?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 気になりますが、再発行できると考えて原本を渡すつもりはありません。その相談は受付に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再発行できると思って原本を渡さず受付へ条件を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, but I will not hand over the original assuming it can be reissued. I will ask reception about that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not hand over the original assuming reissuance; ask reception about the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付で必要な確認をしてください。今日はこの二枚の扱いが主な相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make the necessary checks at reception. Is handling these two papers your main question today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。会社の指定を確かめるまでは手元に保管し、必要なら受付にも書類名を伝えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社指定が分かるまで二枚を保管し必要なら受付へ書類名で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Until I know the company's requirements, I will keep them with me and, if necessary, give reception the document names when asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep both papers until the company's requirements are known, and if needed consult reception using the document names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。封筒に入れてお持ちください。書類のお忘れ物がないよう、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please put them in an envelope and take them with you. Make sure you leave no documents behind, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵が見当たらないというご相談ですね。ご自身が使う鍵でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find some keys. Are they keys you use yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から一時的に預かった鍵束です。自分の鍵は別にあり、なくしたのは友人のものです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の鍵はあり預かった友人の鍵束を見失ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: They are a bunch I was temporarily holding for a friend. My own keys are separate; the missing ones belong to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have your own keys and have lost sight of the bunch entrusted by your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 預かった経緯と、最後に持っていた場所を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you explain how you came to hold them and where you last had them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が運動する間に預かり、施設の休憩席で鞄を開けたときにはありました。その後がはっきりしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運動中の友人から預かり休憩席で鞄を開けた時まであったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I held them while my friend exercised. They were still there when I opened my bag at the facility's resting seats. What happened afterward is unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you held them for your exercising friend and last had them when opening your bag at the resting seats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かるところまでで結構です。鍵束に付いている物は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tell me only what you know. Do you remember anything attached to the bunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい木の札が付いていました。文字は覚えていないので、友人に写真があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木札の文字を覚えていないため友人に写真の有無を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There was a small wooden tag. I do not remember the writing, so I would like to ask my friend whether they have a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Since you do not remember the writing on the wooden tag, ask your friend whether there is a photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち主の方に特徴を確認できますね。施設にも見つかっていないか尋ねましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the features with the owner. Have you asked the facility whether the keys were found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。席の位置を友人と確かめて施設に連絡します。自分の鍵の特徴と混ぜないようメモを分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席を友人と確かめ施設に連絡し二人の鍵特徴を別々にメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I will check the seat location with my friend and contact the facility. I will keep separate notes so I do not mix up their features with my own keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the seat with your friend, contact the facility, and record each person's key features separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれを区別して記録しましょう。持ち主の方には紛失したことを伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us record them distinctly. Have you told the owner the keys are lost?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 探していることだけ伝えました。見つかっていないことを説明し、相談の際に必要な持ち主の情報も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未発見の現状を説明して相談に必要な持ち主情報を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I only told them I was looking. I will explain that they have not been found and check the owner's information needed for the consultation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that they remain missing and check the owner's information required for the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。分かった特徴と経緯を追加でお知らせください。ご友人への連絡も忘れず、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please tell us any further features and circumstances you establish. Remember to contact your friend, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票がありましたか。荷物について、ほかに分かっていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there a missed-delivery notice? What else do you know about the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族が今朝一つ受け取りました。でも、ポストにこの票があったので、もう一つ届くのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝に家族が一箱受領したが不在票があり別荷物か迷うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A family member received one this morning. But this notice was in the mailbox, so I am unsure whether another parcel is coming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your family received one box this morning but a notice remains, so you are unsure whether it is another parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取った荷物の番号と、この票の番号を比べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you compare the number on the received parcel with the number on this notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受け取った箱の写真があります。番号の末尾は似ていますが、全部をまだ比べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 箱写真があるが似た末尾だけで全体をまだ照合していないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of the box. The last digits look similar, but I have not compared the whole number yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have a box photo but have only seen similar final digits and not matched the whole number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 末尾だけでなく番号全体を確認しましょう。票に書かれた配達の日時も見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the whole number, not just the ending. Shall we also look at the delivery date and time on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この票は昨日の午後です。今朝より前ですが、それだけで同じ荷物とは決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日午後の票は朝の受領前だが時刻だけで同一荷物と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. This notice is from yesterday afternoon. It is earlier than this morning, but I will not decide it is the same parcel based only on that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say yesterday afternoon's notice predates this morning's receipt, but time alone does not prove it is the same parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 時刻と番号を合わせて確認できますね。受け取ったご家族にも状況を尋ねられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check time and number together. Can you also ask the family member who received it what happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話で、受け取った箱がいくつあったかと、宛名を聞きます。写真で読めない番号も確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱数と宛名と読めない番号を家族に電話で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will phone and ask how many boxes they received and the addressee. I will also have them check the digits I cannot read in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Phone your family to ask the box count, addressee, and unreadable digits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報があると相談しやすくなります。再配達の依頼はもうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That information will help with your inquiry. Have you already requested redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだです。受取状況と番号が分かるまで依頼せず、この票が残っている理由を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状況と番号が分かるまで依頼せず票が残る理由を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will not request it until I know the receipt situation and number; I will ask why this notice remains.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not request until the situation and number are known, and ask why the notice remains. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、確認した情報をお持ちください。重複しないよう整理してから進めましょう。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please bring the information you have checked. Let us organize it before proceeding to avoid duplication. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが見当たらないとのことですね。この銀行のカードだと確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find a card. Have you confirmed it is this bank's card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布に一枚足りません。ただ、似た色の会員証も入れているので、なくしたのが銀行のカードかまだ分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 似色の会員証もあり足りない一枚が銀行カードか不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: One card is missing from my wallet. But I also carry a membership card of a similar color, so I do not yet know whether the missing one is the bank card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a similar-colored membership card makes it unclear whether the missing card is the bank card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、手元に残っているカードを整理しましょう。番号を声に出さず、種類だけ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First organize the cards you still have. Do not read out the numbers; just tell me the types.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会員証はここにあり、銀行のカードが見当たりません。色の記憶だけで話しかけてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会員証を確認して銀行カードがないと分かり色だけの判断を直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The membership card is here, and I cannot find the bank card. I approached you based only on my memory of the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the membership card, establish the bank card is missing, and correct your color-based judgment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行のカードについて担当が状況を確認します。最後に使ったときの記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The responsible staff will check the bank card's situation. Do you have a record of when you last used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買い物の後に財布を開けましたが、その時点であったかは曖昧です。覚えていない部分は推測せず伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布を開けた時にカードがあったか不明で推測しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I opened my wallet after shopping, but I am unsure whether it was there then. I will describe what I do not remember without guessing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it is unclear whether the card was there when opening the wallet, and do not guess. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままの状況をお話しください。利用状態の確認や紛失時の手続きについて相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please describe the situation as it is. Would you like to discuss checking its use status and procedures for a lost card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。先に状態の確認と必要な手続きを担当に相談したいです。連絡先を自分で探すより、この窓口の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 利用状態と紛失対応を先に相談し窓口の正式案内を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. First I want to ask the responsible staff about its status and the necessary procedures. Rather than search for a contact myself, I will check this counter's guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: First ask about use status and lost-card procedures, and check the counter's official guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当の案内をお待ちください。もし後から見つかった場合も、その時点の状況を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait for the staff's instructions. If you later find it, check its status at that point as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかっただけで使えるとは決めず、今回の相談内容をメモし、次に何を確認するか担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見つかっても利用可と決めず相談内容をメモし次の確認を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not assume finding it means it can be used. I will note today's consultation and ask the staff what to check next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not assume a found card is usable; note the consultation and ask what to check next. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当につなぎます。残っているカードは財布へ戻して、置き忘れのないようお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will connect you to the responsible staff. Put the remaining cards back in your wallet and be careful not to leave them behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保存容器についてですね。気になった箇所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a food-storage container. Which part concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ふたの端が欠けています。使う前に洗おうとして気づいたので、まだ食品は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗う前にふた端の欠けを発見し食品を入れていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The lid's edge is chipped. I noticed when about to wash it before use, so I have not put food inside yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found the lid's chipped edge before washing and have not put food in it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 気づいたときの状況を伺います。買った後に落としたり、重い物を載せたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me ask about the situation when you noticed it. After buying it, did you drop it or put something heavy on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 落としてはいませんが、帰りの袋には缶詰も入れていました。店で欠けていたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 落下はないが缶詰と同じ袋で購入時の状態は見ていないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not drop it, but there were canned foods in the same bag on the way home. I did not check whether it was chipped in the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it was not dropped but shared a bag with cans, and you did not check its condition when buying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入前の状態は不明なのですね。包装やレシートは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: So the condition before purchase is unknown. Have you kept the packaging and receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 包装は残っています。紙のレシートは見つからないので、購入記録として使える物を教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装はあるがレシートがなく使える購入記録を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the packaging. I cannot find the paper receipt, so I would like to know what can be used as a purchase record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the packaging but no receipt, and ask what purchase record can be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の確認方法は担当に尋ねます。欠けている部分の写真は撮れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the person responsible how records can be checked. Can you photograph the chipped part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真を撮ってあります。破片も残っていますが、持って来る物と包み方を先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真と破片があり持参物と包み方を先に確かめたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have taken photos. I also have the broken piece, but I want to check what to bring and how to wrap it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have photos and the broken piece and want to check what to bring and how to wrap it first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちいただく物と方法を確認してご案内します。今は使用を始めず、状態を見られるよう残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check what and how you should bring it and explain. For now, do not start using it; keep it so its condition can be examined.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 使用せず、包装と写真をそろえます。交換できると決めず、状態と購入の確認をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未使用で包装写真を準備し交換前提にせず状態と購入確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not use it, and will prepare the packaging and photos. I will not assume it can be exchanged; I would like the condition and purchase checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep it unused, prepare packaging and photos, and request condition and purchase checks without assuming an exchange. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当に確認してまいります。ご相談ありがとうございます。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the person responsible. Thank you for asking. Take care going home.
